# Legacy RGI fixture

`baseline/odd-small.rgi` was generated by rg_image commit
`14e48b2970aacfce45d852708cbefaeaf3f91fe8` before the performance changes.
It is an original, synthetic 17x19 RGBA8 image encoded with profile 1.
The exact pixel formula is in `test_legacy_fixture` in the test suite.
The existing inline sample in that suite separately covers profile 0.

This fixture contains no external or private artwork and is under the
repository's MIT license. Do not regenerate it with the candidate encoder.
